# TeachChemistry.org

> > TeachChemistry.org is the educational platform of the American Chemical Society (ACS) providing chemistry teaching resources, lesson plans, and classroom activities for educators.

The site serves as the hub for AACT (American Association of Chemistry Teachers), offering curated content for chemistry education including Chemistry Club themes, Mole Day celebrations, and professional development resources. Members access exclusive teaching materials, lesson plans, and community resources through the ACS member portal.

## Key Topics

- American Chemical Society (ACS)
- AACT (American Association of Chemistry Teachers)
- Chemistry Education
- Mole Day
- Chemistry Club Activities
- Educational Resources
- STEM Teaching
- Chemistry Lesson Plans
- Teacher Professional Development
- Chemistry Themes
- Classroom Activities
- Member Resources
- Chemistry Standards
- Laboratory Safety
